scope: Callgrind guest instructions attributed to the outer source-backed edit_sheets planning operation, including MultiSnapshot selector/catalog/closure construction and selected worksheet loading; staging, commit, publication, and returned edit teardown are outside the owner.
selection_policy: Select the measured dump by one positive owner incoming edge from run_xlsx_cell_values_edit_save; select lifecycle dumps by one positive owner incoming edge from run_xlsx_cell_value_lifecycle_gates. Retain every numbered raw dump and the zero-Ir termination dump.
call_count_basis: The lifecycle gate invokes edit_sheets for no-op, clear, and remove. Its foreign-source checks call publication only. The measured one-percent loop invokes edit_sheets once per one-sample child.
claim: Attribution only; Callgrind Ir is a guest-instruction mechanism diagnostic and is not a latency, hardware-cycle, allocation, or production-change claim.
